import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_4.csv"
]

# Read all source files into dataframes with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(path, index_col=0) for path in source_files]

# Standardize 'Sex' column values to integers as per target schema:
# From source examples, 'Sex' can be 'Female', 'Male', 'Refused'
# Target schema expects integer for 'Sex'.
# We map: Female -> 10, Male -> 11, Refused -> 0 (assuming 0 for refused/missing)
sex_mapping = {
    'Female': 10,
    'Male': 11,
    'Refused': 0
}

for df in dfs:
    # Map 'Sex' column to integer codes
    df['Sex'] = df['Sex'].map(sex_mapping).fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Ensure all other columns are integers (fill NaN with 0 and convert)
    # Columns: "Don't know/Refused/Missing", "Normal Weight", "Obese", "Overweight", "Underweight"
    for col in ["Don't know/Refused/Missing", "Normal Weight", "Obese", "Overweight", "Underweight"]:
        # Some source files have float NaNs, convert to int after filling NaN with 0
        df[col] = df[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Ensure 'Age Group' is string type (should be already)
    df['Age Group'] = df['Age Group'].astype(str)

# UNION operation: concatenate all dataframes vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = ['Age Group', 'Sex', "Don't know/Refused/Missing", 'Normal Weight', 'Obese', 'Overweight', 'Underweight']
target_df = target_df[target_columns]

# Write the result to the target CSV file without the index column
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Convert all numeric columns to numeric type (some have floats and NaNs)
for df in [df0, df1, df2, df3, df4]:
    for col in ["Don't know/Refused/Missing", "Normal Weight", "Obese", "Overweight", "Underweight"]:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    # Sex column in target is integer, but source Sex is string, so map Sex to integer codes
    # We will map Sex categories to integers consistently across all dfs
    # Collect all unique Sex values from all dfs
sex_values = pd.concat([df0['Sex'], df1['Sex'], df2['Sex'], df3['Sex'], df4['Sex']]).unique()
sex_map = {v: i+1 for i, v in enumerate(sorted(sex_values))}
# Apply mapping
for df in [df0, df1, df2, df3, df4]:
    df['Sex'] = df['Sex'].map(sex_map).fillna(0).astype(int)

# Join all source tables on 'Age Group'
# Start with df0, join df1..df4 one by one on 'Age Group'
# Since all tables have same schema, but target schema expects aggregation per Age Group,
# we will join on Age Group and sum all numeric columns from all tables

# To join all tables on 'Age Group', we first rename columns in df1..df4 to avoid collision
# But since we want to sum all values per Age Group, better to concatenate all rows and then groupby Age Group

# Concatenate all source tables vertically (union)
df_all = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3, df4], ignore_index=True)

# Group by 'Age Group' and aggregate sums for all numeric columns including 'Sex'
result = df_all.groupby('Age Group').agg({
    'Sex': 'sum',
    "Don't know/Refused/Missing": 'sum',
    'Normal Weight': 'sum',
    'Obese': 'sum',
    'Overweight': 'sum',
    'Underweight': 'sum'
}).reset_index()

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
result = result[['Age Group', 'Sex', "Don't know/Refused/Missing", 'Normal Weight', 'Obese', 'Overweight', 'Underweight']]

# Write to output CSV
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_49/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
